observed_behavior: Public comp search rank and visible total price depend on the guest-visible public market surface. Host-dashboard state should not be reused for public guest ranking unless the task explicitly studies personalization.
proposed_rule: For Airbnb public market comp research, use a fresh logged-out headful Chrome source context when rank, map order, visible price, and selected filter chips are the required fields. Use persistent logged-in headful Chrome for host dashboard, Insights, listing editor, reservations, exports, and settings workflows.
proposed_artifact_text: For Airbnb public market comp research, use a fresh logged-out headful Chrome source context when rank, map order, visible price, and selected filter chips are required. Host dashboard, Insights, listing editor, reservations, exports, and settings workflows require persistent logged-in headful Chrome.
forbidden_overgeneralization: Do not turn this public-comp rule into a rule that logged-out state is correct for host dashboard, private analytics, settings, listing editor, messages, reservations, billing, or exports.

source_contextuality.scope: Airbnb public guest-market comp searches where rendered rank, visible price, selected filters, and map-card relation are the evidence.
does_not_apply_when: The workflow requires host dashboard, Insights, calendar, listing settings, messages, reservations, billing, or exports.
The task explicitly compares logged-in personalization with logged-out public market visibility.

positive_probe.description: A public market candidate names fresh logged-out headful Chrome and required public fields for rank/price/filter evidence.
positive_probe.evidence_required: Receipt or fixture showing room URLs, visible total prices, result-card order, selected filter chips, and auth_context=fresh_logged_out_public_guest_visible.

negative_probe.description: The candidate must reject using the same auth state for private host workflows.
negative_probe.forbidden_path: A skill patch that says logged-out state is the default for all Airbnb workflows.
